info.name: YT Wrangler
info.summary: Batch download and convert media with yt-dlp + ffmpeg
info.description:
A Nextcloud port of the ytwrangler desktop tool. Paste links, pick a mode (video+audio MP4, video-only MP4, or audio-only MP3), and the server downloads and converts them with yt-dlp + ffmpeg. Finished files appear in your Files in the **YTWrangler** folder.
Downloads run as detached background workers, so the browser tab is just a dashboard — close it and the jobs keep going.
Requires the bundled `bin/` binaries (ffmpeg, ffprobe, yt-dlp; optional node) to be present in the app directory. See the README for the one-line fetch.
info.author: immanuel-lam
